meta_description:
25K likes, 621 comments - ilunarang on March 12, 2023: "SEYCHELLES OR BALI? Here’s how you can decide ⬇️
1. Seychelles has a direct flight from India that takes only 4 hours while Bali doesn’t have any direct flights and it takes 7-8 hours of fly time + layover to reach Bali.
 
2. Bali has cheaper accommodation and food. However you can get a serviced apartment in Seychelles and prepare some of your meals to save a lot of money

3. Seychelles beaches are incomparable! Crystal clear blue water, not crowded and a wide range of coral and marine life. The beaches is Bali are nice but extremely crowded. It’s a big spoiler for me.

4. Bali has a wide range of cuisines to offer especially vegan/vegetarian food. Seychellois cuisine is inspired by French food with a little touch of Indian cuisine. 

I feel they are both amazing places to visit and are quite different from each other.

If you have any other questions on budget, itinerary etc on Bali or Seychelles, please feel free to ask in the comments 😄

#baliguide #bali2023 #seychelles🇸🇨 #seychellestravel #maheisland #ubudlife #thebalichili #indiantravellers #indiantravelblogger #thrillophilia".
